title: Bind remaining existing dynamic families in the shared canonical artifact registry
description: Stage 2 reusable migration platform only. Preserve all legacy routes until every family passes actual parity. Reuse existing canonical business reads/exporters, current menu/row/column/data-scope checks and audit correlation. No standalone report, arbitrary SQL/joins, schema or production operations, permission expansion or Agent work. Missing canonical/encoding/environment evidence fails closed with precise reason, never caller proof booleans. ERP-337 LegacyReportArtifactCatalog.BuildCapabilities supports only sales-order, receivable and purchase-order dynamic artifacts while BlockedDynamicKeys retains fifteen existing families. Their existing API canonical rules/renderers and source handlers already exist. Extend finite shared adapters for those existing families as one platform increment; ERP-337 completion is not complete dynamic migration.
implementation_evidence: ERP-337 LegacyReportArtifactCatalog.BuildCapabilities supports only sales-order, receivable and purchase-order dynamic artifacts while BlockedDynamicKeys retains fifteen existing families. Their existing API canonical rules/renderers and source handlers already exist. Extend finite shared adapters for those existing families as one platform increment; ERP-337 completion is not complete dynamic migration.
acceptance_criteria: Resolve every existing BlockedDynamicKeys family to its existing permission-aware canonical business query and actual Excel/PDF renderer through finite shared bindings; preserve raw null, grouped totals, currency/unit and selected-page versus all-match meaning. No generic exporter used as legacy output and no per-report controllers or new report families.

Keep precise unsupported capability reasons only for genuinely unavailable source/renderers; missing dependencies, revoked permissions, cancellation, invalid scope and over-budget reads return no promotable artifact evidence with correlated audit. Current-user checks occur in original service paths and before returning bytes.

Verify the finite existing dynamic catalog matrix, each canonical mapping and negative authorization/boundary cases with actual bytes and guarded nonempty local SQL fixtures; safe Release/unit and automation contracts pass. Keep all legacy entries until all fixed/dynamic/export/print families migrate.
